analysis_notes: FINOS CDM repository demonstrates mature governance with structured working groups, milestone-based planning, and careful backward compatibility management. The project coordinates major releases consolidating breaking changes while maintaining parallel minor releases. Key challenges include state management fragility from nested objects, qualification function misalignment, insufficient component granularity, and FpML integration maintenance burden. The FRAGMOS initiative exemplifies systematic domain improvement methodology. Smart contracts and blockchain identifiers emerging as new use cases. Rosetta DSL multi-language code generation is foundational capability. Strong community engagement evidenced by high-comment issues and working group meetings.
